name: Tajikistan
headline: Tajikistan: +8.4% growth in 2025, 3.4% inflation, debt 19% of GDP
sections: Tajikistan is a $17.5 billion economy (2025), the world's 140th-largest of 215 measured. Real output grew +8.4% in 2025, faster than the world median of +3.5%. Income per person is $5,923 at purchasing-power parity (2025), against a world median of $21K. Manufacturing accounts for 13.2% of GDP (2024).

Consumer prices rose 3.4% in 2025, broadly within typical target ranges, down from 6.6% in 2022. Unemployment stood at 6.9% (2025), above the world median of 5.1%. Youth unemployment was 14.6% (2025).
Gross government debt is 19% of GDP (2025), a low level that has fallen from 51% in 2020. The general government balance is +0.5% of GDP (2025), a surplus.
The current account balance is +17.2% of GDP (2025), a large surplus. Trade equals 59% of GDP (2024), a fairly open economy. Net FDI inflows were 0.5% of GDP (2025).
IMF projections put government debt at 22% of GDP by 2031, still rising from today's level. Life expectancy is 71.9 years (2024). Population: 10.4 million (2025).
note: Built from official World Bank and IMF data; IMF projections are labelled as projections.
